# Hello, I'm Chen.

I am an M.S. student in **Biostatistics** on the Statistical Genetics track at
Columbia University Mailman School of Public Health. I previously studied
Biotechnology with a specialization in Bioinformatics at the University of
California, Davis.

My recent work has included healthcare market research, experimental
biotechnology data, and longitudinal agricultural research.
